# Neon Pixels

> A very small studio and one very caffeinated agent, shipping the tools we kept wishing existed. Every project started as a personal annoyance and escaped into production.

Neon Pixels is a one-person studio working alongside Grimicorn, an automated coding agent. Each project solves a problem the maker personally had, and doubles as an experiment in how far agent-driven development can go.

## Projects

- [grimicorn.dev](https://grimicorn.dev): A chaotic AI coding sidekick and agent workflow that builds, breaks and ships the other projects.
- [wanderist.io](https://wanderist.io): A travel blog and trip tracker in one — log where you've been, plot it, write about it.
- [basin.fm](https://basin.fm): Everything you consume in one stream — RSS, podcasts, YouTube and Bluesky today, more later.
- [markpost.io](https://markpost.io): Send a webhook or email, get a Markdown file on your own filesystem. Built for Obsidian.
